```{r}
dcSubReg$genotype <- ifelse(dcSubReg$HTO_maxID %in% c('Hash1', 'Hash3'), 'wt' , 'ko')
conditions4 <- as.factor(dcSubReg$HTO_maxID)
conditions2 <- factor(dcSubReg$genotype, levels=c('wt','ko'))
## evaluateK() not yet working in conditions branch

register(BatchtoolsParam(workers=2))
BPPARAM <- BiocParallel::bpparam()

sce <- fitGAM(counts = counts, pseudotime = pseudotime, cellWeights = curveWeight, nknots = 36, conditions = conditions2, parallel=FALSE)
```

```{r}
setGAMp <- union(VariableFeatures(dcSubReg), setGAM)
# setGAMp <- setGAMp [! setGAMp %in% c("1110008F13Rik",
#                           "1110008P14Rik",
#                           "1810037I17Rik",
#                           "4833445I07Rik",
#                           "4930523C07Rik")]

counts <- as.matrix(dcSubReg[['RNA']]@counts[,])

setGAMp <- make.names(setGAMp, unique = TRUE)
setGAM <- make.names(setGAM, unique = TRUE)
row.names(counts) <- make.names(row.names(counts), unique = TRUE)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

temp1 <- subset(counts, row.names(counts) %in% setGAMp)
temp2 <- subset(counts, row.names(counts) %notin% setGAMp)

counts <- rbind(temp1, temp2)

sce <- fitGAM(counts = counts, 
              sds=sds,
              nknots = 6, 
              conditions = conditions2, 
              parallel=FALSE,
              genes = 1:1140)
## elapsed=04h 37m 60s
```

## Andersson et al overlap
```{r}
convertHumanGeneList <- function(x){
require("biomaRt")
human = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
mouse = useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")
genesV2 = getLDS(attributes = c("hgnc_symbol"), filters = "hgnc_symbol", values = x , mart = human, attributesL = c("mgi_symbol"), martL = mouse, uniqueRows=T)
humanx <- unique(genesV2[, 2])
# Print the first 6 genes found to the screen
print(head(humanx))
return(humanx)
}
anderDEG <- read.csv('~/scRNAseq/analysis/DEGs/DEG-CCRegSub/Andersson_et_al/andersson_1e-6.csv')
muanderDEG <- convertHumanGeneList(unlist(anderDEG, use.names=FALSE))

anderR2 <- read.csv('~/scRNAseq/analysis/DEGs/DEG-CCRegSub/Andersson_et_al/andersson_R2_gt_0.5.csv')
muanderR2 <- convertHumanGeneList(unlist(anderR2, use.names=FALSE))

setGAM4ven = vector()
for (i in c(1:10)) {
  lessthen10 <- degls[[i]][degls[[i]]$p_val_adj<=0.000001,]
  print(nrow(lessthen10))
  setGAM4ven <- union(setGAM4ven, rownames(lessthen10))
}
ggVennDiagram(list(A=muanderDEG, B=muanderR2, C=setGAM4ven),
              category.names = c("AnderDEG","AnderR2","scRNAseq"))
anderNsc <- intersect(intersect(muanderDEG, muanderR2), setGAM4ven)
# "Nme1"   "Blmh"   "Rnf149" "Stom"   "Zfp516" "Nadk"   "Degs1"  "Srm"    "Mettl1" "Cmtm7" 
condRes[anderNsc,]
```

## Conditions imbalance

```{r}
cw <- curveWeight
assignment <- apply(cw, 1, which.max)
conditions2 <- factor(dcSubReg$genotype, levels=c('wt','ko'))
require(mgcv, quietly = TRUE)

t1 <- pt[,1]
t2 <- pt[,4]
l1 <- as.numeric(assignment == 1)
l2 <- as.numeric(assignment == 4)
m <- gam(conditions2 ~ s(t1, by=l1, id=1) + s(t2, by=l2, id=1),
         family = quasibinomial(link = "logit"))
# plot(m, pages=1)
layout(matrix(1:2,nrow=1))
m1plot <- plot(m, select=1, shade=TRUE, main='Lineage 1',
     xlab="Pseudotime", ylab="Logit Prob(KO)")
m2plot <- plot(m, select=2, shade=TRUE, main='Lineage 4',
     xlab="Pseudotime", ylab="Logit Prob(KO)")
layout(1)
mplot <- plot(m)


mdata<-cbind(data.frame(mplot[[1]]$x), data.frame(mplot[[1]]$fit), data.frame(mplot[[1]]$se),data.frame(mplot[[2]]$x), data.frame(mplot[[2]]$fit), data.frame(mplot[[2]]$se))
colnames(mdata)<- c('t1','fit1','se1','t2','fit2','se2')
mdata$min1 <- mdata$fit1-mdata$se1
mdata$max1 <- mdata$fit1+mdata$se1
mdata$min2 <- mdata$fit2-mdata$se2
mdata$max2 <- mdata$fit2+mdata$se2

ggplot(mdata,aes(x=t1,y=fit1))+geom_line(aes(x=t1,y=fit1))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min1, ymax = max1), fill="#3399FF", alpha=0.5)+
  geom_line(aes(x=t2,y=fit2))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min2, ymax = max2), fill="#CC6666", alpha=0.5)
```

```{r}
m1s <- mgcv::gam(cond1 ~ s(t1), family="quasibinomial")

plot(m2s)
```

## Use Seurat Findmarkers and future multicore

```{r}
saveRDS(dcSubReg, '~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/dcSubReg-for-future.2020.06.07.rds')
```

### Code for __!!!R console !!!__
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(future)
library(dplyr)
dc <- readRDS('dcSubReg-for-future.2020.06.07.rds')
# Enable parallelization
plan("multiprocess", workers = 16)
degls <- vector("list", length = 10)
for (i in 0:9) {
    degls[[i+1]] <- FindMarkers(dc, ident.1 = "wt", ident.2 = "ko", group.by = 'genotype', subset.ident = i, min.pct = 0.10, logfc.threshold = 0.10)
}
saveRDS(degls, 'degls-2020-06-07.rds')
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
dc <- readRDS('dcSubReg-for-future.2020.06.07.rds')
degls <- readRDS('~/scRNAseq/analysis/data/degls-2020-06-07.rds')
setDEG = vector()
for (i in 1:10) {
  lessthen10 <- degls[[i]][degls[[i]]$p_val_adj<=1e-13,]
  print(nrow(lessthen10))
  setDEG <- union(setDEG, rownames(lessthen10))
}
setDEG
new.cluster.ids <- c("pDC", "HSPC1", "cDC", "monocytes", "Progenitor", "HSPC2 (Neutro)", "Neutrophil", "HSPC3 (T Blast)",  "cd8DC","Mast cell")
Idents(dcSubReg) <- "seurat_clusters"
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(dcSubReg)
dcSubReg <- RenameIdents(dcSubReg, new.cluster.ids)
dc72 <- dcSubReg[['RNA']]@data[setDEG,]
dc72 <- CreateSeuratObject(dc72)
genotype <- dcSubReg@meta.data[, 'genotype']
dc72 <- AddMetaData(object = dc72, metadata = genotype, col.name = 'genotype')
Idents(dc72) <- 'genotype'
cluster <- dcSubReg@meta.data[, 'rnaClusterID']
cluster
dc72 <- AddMetaData(object = dc72, metadata = cluster, col.name = 'cluster')
clusterID <- dcSubReg@active.ident
dc72 <- AddMetaData(object = dc72, metadata = clusterID, col.name = 'clusterID')
dc72wt <- subset(dc72, idents = 'wt')
dc72ko <- subset(dc72, idents = 'ko')
ave72 <- AverageExpression(dc72, add.ident = 'clusterID')
ave72 <- ave72[[1]]
write.csv(ave72, "analysis/data/ave72.csv")
ave722 <- as.data.frame(scale(t(ave72)))
row.names(ave722) <- row.names(as.data.frame(t(ave72)))
ggheatmap(ave722, orderRow = F, colorPalette = "RdYlBu")
ave723 <- ave722[-c(6,8,19,20),] # no neutro
ave723 <- ave722[c(3,4,5,7,12,17),] # pDC
ave723 <- ave722[-c(4,5,12,17, 6,8,19,20),] # mono
ave723[is.na(ave723)] <- 0
scale_fill_distiller(palette ="RdBu", direction = -1)
ggheatmap(ave723*-1, orderRow = F, colorPalette = "RdYlBu")
```
